Parametric-bootstrap goodness-of-fit test

pb_gof.Rd

Simulates and refits responses under a fitted count or binomial regression model to approximate the goodness-of-fit statistic's reference distribution.

Usage

pb_gof(
  model,
  n = 1000,
  statistic = c("deviance", "pearson", "zeros"),
  seed = NULL,
  workers = 1L
)

Arguments

model

Supported binomial, Poisson or MASS negative-binomial GLM.

n

Positive number of bootstrap replicates.

statistic

Deviance, Pearson residual sum of squares, or zero count.

seed

Optional reproducibility seed.

workers

Number of processes for refitting.

Details

The upper-tail p-value uses (1 + exceedances) / (1 + valid replicates). Failed refits are excluded. This procedure is conditional on the fitted sampling model and does not prove model correctness. The zero-count statistic is supported only for unweighted count data.

Value

A pb_gof object with fields statistic, observed, reference, p_value, n, failed, warned, model, seed, and call.

Examples

fit <- glm(vs ~ mpg, data = mtcars, family = binomial())
pb_gof(fit, n = 30, seed = 1)
